items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: So I worked for him for three years after the Whiteman, after I got out of the Whiteman bands and he was excellent.

ctx.x: And besides, he recorded so many bands that he had a great appreciation of what each band was like, and he was never like King down there. He never -- he always tried to help. If he could put in a little part, put a celeste part in, which he did for us one time, he would do things like that, never cut you down.

So I worked for him for three years after the Whiteman, after I got out of the Whiteman bands and he was excellent. We had a little style, and there was a little style to the band. We had a fine band, you know. Then we had both Dorseys and Artie Shaw. And guys like that we had in the band.
But I think the show come on about Saturday evening when it was -- what do they call that -- that's --
